An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on a guest OS in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the SetGuestInfo RPC function. A crafted request can trigger the dereference of a null pointer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition to users of the guest OS.
